title: Shine On, O Fourteenth Full Moon (Tyngshain Ko Nai-khadsaw)
cultural_context: Ode to the fourteenth night full moon (Nai-khadsaw) illuminating highland pine ridges and monoliths.
lyrics_khasi:
Tyngshain, ko nai-khadsaw synnia,
Ha kliar u Lum Shillong,
Me pynshai ia ki kshaid
Bad ki madan ka shnong;
Ki diengkseh ki thaba rupa
Haba jingshai jong me ka hap,
Ka miet ka kynjah jar,
Ha ka jingkmen ba dap.

Hapdeng ka jingshai jong me,
U minstrel u rwai duitara,
Sur thiang ka sawa jai-jai
Ha man ki sawdong pneh;
Tyngshain, ko bnai ba bha,
Ai jingsuk ha ka ri,
Pynklet ia man ka khuslai
Haduh ba sngi kan mih.
lyrics_english:
Shine brightly, O fourteenth-night moon,
Above the crest of Shillong Peak,
You illuminate the waterfalls
And the village meadows below;
The pine trees shimmer like silver
Where your soft lunar rays fall,
The night reposes in deep hush,
Filled with peaceful joy.

Bathed within your soft light,
The minstrel plays his Duitara,
Sweet melodies echoing gently
Across each hillside fold;
Shine on, O gentle moon,
Bring peace unto our land,
Banish all human worries
Until the morrow's sun shall rise.

khasi: Haba jingshai jong me ka hap,
english: Above the crest of Shillong Peak,
The pine trees shimmer like silver
Where your soft lunar rays fall,
The night reposes in deep hush,
Until the morrow's sun shall rise.
